requirements.heading: MIME-Version Header Field
requirements.text: Messages composed in accordance with this document MUST include such a header field, with the following verbatim text:

requirements.heading: Quoted-Printable Content-Transfer-Encoding
requirements.text: (2) (Literal representation) Octets with decimal values of 33 through 60 inclusive, and 62 through 126, inclusive, MAY be represented as the US-ASCII characters which correspond to those octets (EXCLAMATION POINT through LESS THAN, and GREATER THAN through TILDE, respectively).

requirements.heading: Quoted-Printable Content-Transfer-Encoding
requirements.text: (3) (White Space) Octets with values of 9 and 32 MAY be represented as US-ASCII TAB (HT) and SPACE characters,

requirements.heading: Quoted-Printable Content-Transfer-Encoding
requirements.text: respectively, but MUST NOT be so represented at the end of an encoded line.

requirements.heading: Quoted-Printable Content-Transfer-Encoding
requirements.text: Any TAB (HT) or SPACE characters on an encoded line MUST thus be followed on that line by a printable character.

requirements.heading: Quoted-Printable Content-Transfer-Encoding
requirements.text: transport-padding := *LWSP-char ; Composers MUST NOT generate ; non-zero length transport ; padding, but receivers MUST ; be able to handle padding ; added by message transports.
